## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `scripts/audit-public-release.ps1` successfully.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete staged filename list.
- [ ] Python tools parse successfully.
- [ ] Android changes were built or the missing build environment is explained.
- [ ] New screenshots were manually inspected at full resolution.

## Public-release checklist

- [ ] No ROMs, BIOS files, RetroArch cores, APKs, AABs, archives, or signing material.
- [ ] No production PINs, PIN hashes from production builds, passwords, tokens, or environment files.
- [ ] No private IP addresses, household hostnames, MAC addresses, device serials, or account identifiers.
- [ ] No logs, caches, local user paths, private reports, or device-state files.
- [ ] Any game content shown is legally redistributable.
- [ ] Product concepts are labeled as concepts and do not imply third-party endorsement.
